name: Too Good To Go surplus-food app
notes: App, not AI: sells surplus food at a discount.

name: French law against food waste (Garot law)
effect: Bans destroying edible unsold food; encourages donation contracts. No measured results found yet.
notes: First national ban of its kind.

name: Winnow Vision
effect: Typical 40–70% kitchen waste reduction, average about 50%
notes: Camera over the bin identifies discarded food; Winnow Track is the non-AI touchscreen version.

name: Flood Hub
effect: Riverine flood forecasts accurate at a 7-day lead time
notes: Historical outputs open as the GRRR dataset (1981–); model not open source.

name: Ahmedabad Heat Action Plan
organization: City of Ahmedabad, with NRDC and the Indian Institute of Public Health
scale: One city; updated yearly; a model for other Indian city heat plans
effect: About 1,100 deaths avoided per year (Journal of Environmental and Public Health, as reported by NRDC)
notes: Early warnings, health-worker training, cooling centers, water and shade. Evidence type from the before/after mortality study; check the paper.

name: Housing First (At Home/Chez Soi trial)
effect: Housed all of the last 6 months: 62% vs 31% with usual care
notes: Housing without preconditions; participants had serious mental illness.

name: Homelessness Prevention Unit (predictive model)
organization: LA County Dept. of Health Services, California Policy Lab
effect: 86% kept housing; 71% less likely to enter shelter or outreach within 18 months than similar non-enrolled people
notes: Model ranks who's most at risk; RCT results expected 2027. Evaluator also built the model.

name: Real Living Wage accreditation
effect: 500,000+ workers got pay rises (Cardiff Business School study)
notes: Voluntary employer accreditation driven by a campaign. The 500,000 figure is a count from a study the Foundation cites, not a causal effect.

name: Young Futures funding challenges
scale: $1M Lonely Hearts Club challenge (2024, 10 nonprofits); $1.4M to 16 nonprofits on youth and AI (2026)
notes: Funders include Pivotal, Susan Crown Exchange, Omidyar Network, Hopelab, Bezos Family Foundation.

name: The Rithm Project
scale: Surveyed 2,000+ young people aged 13–24 on AI use and relationships
notes: Helps young people rebuild and evolve human connection in the age of AI. Funded by Omidyar Network and Young Futures.

name: Agapi.kids
notes: AI tool co-designed with 10- to 19-year-olds to build skills for human connection.

name: Design It For Us
notes: Youth-led advocacy for safer social media and online platforms.

name: Only7Seconds
notes: Reduces youth loneliness through awareness, education and empowerment programs.

name: Letters to Strangers
notes: Youth mental health nonprofit; Young Futures grantee for AI's effects on relationships.

name: 3G intergenerational mentoring
notes: Links preschoolers, teens and older adults through social-emotional learning.

name: Surgeon General advisories on social media and youth mental health, and on loneliness
organization: Office of the U.S. Surgeon General
effect: Calls on policymakers to set youth safety standards and on tech companies to redesign for well-being; declares loneliness a public health crisis.
notes: From Rhea's Rithm Changemaker Network map; evidence checked 2026-10-20.

name: AI companion research and kids' online safety advocacy
effect: Found 72% of teens have used AI companions; recommends no one under 18 use them and backs bans for minors.
notes: From Rhea's Rithm Changemaker Network map; evidence checked 2026-10-20.

name: TAKE IT DOWN Act campaign (non-consensual deepfakes)
organization: Encode and Americans for Responsible Innovation
effect: Petition and coalition campaign preceded the federal law criminalizing non-consensual AI deepfake imagery.
notes: From Rhea's Rithm Changemaker Network map; evidence checked 2026-10-20.

name: New York chatbot kids-safety bill (S.9051/A.10379)
effect: Passed unanimously: limits chatbots' emotional-bond features for minors, with age assurance and a private right of action.
notes: From Rhea's Rithm Changemaker Network map; evidence checked 2026-10-20.

name: ReThink anti-cyberbullying keyboard
effect: In studies with 300+ adolescents, willingness to post offensive messages fell from 71% to 4%.
notes: ML flags offensive messages before sending. From Rhea's Rithm Changemaker Network map; evidence checked 2026-10-20.

name: Kid-safe smartphone OS
effect: No social media or open app store; AI filtering of inappropriate texts and images; features expand as the child grows.
notes: From Rhea's Rithm Changemaker Network map; evidence checked 2026-10-20.

name: NoSo November detox challenge
notes: Youth-led; Young Futures grantee. From Rhea's Rithm Changemaker Network map; evidence checked 2026-10-20.

name: JED Campus
scale: 440+ campuses in a 4-year mental-health systems program
notes: From Rhea's Rithm Changemaker Network map; evidence checked 2026-10-20.

name: Relational Tech Project neighborhood tools
effect: Tools built so online actions end in in-person contact.
notes: From Rhea's Rithm Changemaker Network map; evidence checked 2026-10-20.

name: Hopelab youth mental health research and funding
effect: Research on why youth turn to AI chatbots for emotional support and the risks (dependency, sycophancy, privacy).
notes: From Rhea's Rithm Changemaker Network map; evidence checked 2026-10-20.
